reasons: The cited text supports the rationale: 19.1/19.3 supply the workmanlike, conformity, legal-compliance and no-malicious-code warranties, 19.4 supplies repair/replace/refund, and 19.5 expressly preserves express warranties — so the only gap versus the preferred position is the 90-day Deliverable conformity period in 19.2.

The redline is a targeted, minimal edit (changed-character ratio 0.145) that changes only the duration to 'twelve (12) months', leaving the hosted-Services conformity term and the 19.4 remedy intact; deterministic checks confirm the period is validly expressed and ≥ the playbook floor.

Directionally correct for the Customer: extending Deliverable conformity duration is customer-favourable and is justified because Deliverables under Section 1.4 include configurations and integrations (software-like work product) for which the playbook preferred period is 12 months.
The comment is accurate, in the required tone with the [Playbook] prefix, states what changed and why, cites the playbook position, and offers the 90-day fallback.
